item.title: Project Hail Mary: Book vs Movie
item.description:
Wow book reading isn't that painful actually

So back in 11 May, I went to watch Project Hail Mary, which is perhaps one of the best movies I've watched in a long time (There isn't much competition to begin with, I don't watch much movies). It is a Sci-Fi movie that starts out mysterious and melancholic, but ends in a positive note. And to my luck, I stumbled upon the book that the movie adapted from! So during my commuting time, I read the book.

item.title: Bakatako
item.description:
It's like ArtFight... but daily

A while ago, I saw a tweet talking about Bakatako, where artists can share their art, draw people's OCs and draw prompts daily. When people talk about some sort of new and good art website, I often don't feel interested, it's probably gonna die within a few months or at best stay a quiet website. But hearing that it's like a mini ArtFight... I kinda grew interested.

...Continue reading

item.title: The topic of making art friends
item.description:
The loneliness is getting to me

When I was younger, I had a friend who also draws. We used to share our drawings and talk about our interests, but unfortunately, we fell out, and I stopped having contact with her. While I still have bitter feelings, I miss the times when I had a friend that always listened when I share my OCs.

item.title: Kiwi take a god damn break, you're sick
item.description:
Cough

Like I said a while ago, I got sick. However, it's a regular amount of sick to me, so I went outside with my relatives. But it seems that my relatives became so concerned about my sneezy nose that they made me visit a clinic, so uhhh, I guess I am very bad at keeping track of my health.

item.title: Spam calls
item.description:
Gos shut the fuck up

Because we cannot have nice things, everyone has to receive meaningless cold calls or scam calls every day. No matter if you are a worker who has to pay attention to every phone call, or a person who fears the sound of the phone ringing, you definitely HATE these spam calls, they waste your energy and time. So yea this is a post venting about it.

item.title: The person I have forgetten
item.description:
Somewhat unnerving experience I had

I have met many people in my life, and I usually remember someway or the other. While I may be face blind, I can vaguely remember their features in my head. Sometimes I will forget what they look like, but I would at least remember their actions, their words, and how much I can trust them. There is one person whose face I have forgotten, nor her identity, but the fact I forgotten so much about her makes me feel eerie.
